name: ADS Phoenix L1
one_liner: Weekly Level-1 self-certification checklist runner for Revit models.
description: A native C# add-in for Revit 2025 that runs a fixed 22-item Level-1 self-certification checklist across five hard-stop gates, auto-fixes whitelisted issues, and produces a PDF report and a populated checklist workbook to upload alongside the model in ACC.
